_comment: Component breakdown for kanji appearing in the deck. Hand-authored. Component names are conventional radical meanings (grain, step, woman, child...) — deliberately NOT the invented names used by other courses, which are their own creative work. 'parts' omitted for pictographs that don't usefully decompose.

人.note: A pictograph — a figure walking, seen from the side.

日.note: A pictograph — the sun with a mark in the middle.
